fieldValues.title: A restored working copy keeps its source
fieldValues.move: The browser's recovery copy stores where the document came from and the commit it was based on, so a restored session saves back to its source instead of asking for a destination.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Merging: if the source has moved on since that commit, the save is refused and goes to a new branch. Sources that cannot be reopened after a reload stay as they are.
fieldValues.falsifier: After a reload, a person still has to download the copy to get their work back to its source, or a save from a restored session undoes commits made since the copy was taken.
